mapper.select: SELECT a.authority_id, a.authority, ak.expire_time, 'apikey' AS owner FROM base_authority_apikey AS ak INNER JOIN base_authority AS a ON ak.authority_id = a.authority_id WHERE ak.key_id = #{keyId} AND a.status = 1 AND (ak.auth_status IS NULL OR ak.auth_status = 1)
SELECT ak.authority_id FROM base_authority_apikey AS ak WHERE ak.key_id = #{keyId} AND (ak.auth_status IS NULL OR ak.auth_status = 1)
